chunks: "The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم would perform two rak‘ahs for seeking rain and would seek rain while seated."
And he said: "He began with the prayer before the sermon and recited aloud."

key_terms.الْخُطْبَةِ: the sermon; the address associated with the prayer
key_terms.الْقِرَاءَةِ: the recitation; the Qur'anic recitation in the prayer
key_terms.جَهَرَ: he recited aloud; made the recitation audible
key_terms.رَكْعَتَيْنِ: two rak‘ahs; the number of prayer units performed
key_terms.لِلِاسْتِسْقَاءِ: for seeking rain; referring to the special prayer for rain
key_terms.يَسْتَسْقِي: he sought rain; he supplicated to Allah for rainfall

ai.seo_question: How did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم perform the prayer for seeking rain?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the practice of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم in salat al-istisqa', the prayer for seeking rain. It indicates that he performed two rak‘ahs, sought rain while seated, began with the prayer before the sermon, and recited aloud. The report is significant for the jurisprudence and sunnah of this devotional prayer.
